inventory.purpose: Canonical logical inventory for cash-ETF day-trading research

segments.usage_rule: Use records whose America/New_York session date is on or before 2024-10-02. Do not consume the truncated file through EOF.
segments.reason: The file ends with an incomplete record during 2024-10-03, but the earlier complete sessions are decodable and monotonic.

segments.usage_rule: Use all records beginning with the 2024-10-03 session.

tbbo_signal.deduplication_rule: Partition by America/New_York session date: prefix <= 2024-10-02; tail >= 2024-10-03. Never concatenate both files without this cutoff.
tbbo_signal.required_quote_filter: Reject records with nonpositive or crossed bid/ask quotes.
tbbo_signal.feed_limitation: EQUS.MINI is a derived anonymized multi-venue feed and is not documented as official SIP NBBO.

cost.note: The user confirmed the final Databento dashboard usage after all downloads.

warnings: DBN file is truncated or contains an incomplete record

status.action_encoding_note: Names are resolved with databento_dbn enum metadata when integer-coded.

statistics.usage_decision: Use only types with explicit opening/closing/uncrossing/collar semantics and adequate session coverage; venue-specific types remain excluded without venue documentation.

timestamp_interpretation.ts_event: Matching-engine-received timestamp; used for feature observability and ordering.
timestamp_interpretation.ts_recv: Capture-server-received timestamp (DataFrame index before reset); audited but not used to make a signal earlier.
timestamp_interpretation.auction_time: Projected auction timestamp, not publication timestamp or realized print.

tbbo.deduplication_rule_applied: prefix New York dates <= 2024-10-02; tail dates >= 2024-10-03

feed_semantics.description: Derived anonymized multi-venue EQUS.MINI TBBO; each record is a trade event with BBO immediately before the trade's effect.
feed_semantics.quote_age_policy: The schema has no timestamp for when each standing bid/ask was established. Report event wait from order target and capture latency; do not claim true quote age. Reject simulations when no valid pre-trade BBO event appears within the preregistered maximum wait.
